tours.name: Eat your way through Winthrop

stops.name: Vuolo's
stops.line: Italian restaurant serving handmade pasta, seafood and cocktails.

stops.name: Pizza Center
stops.line: Pizza, subs and cookies; moved from 47 Woodside Ave to 15 Walden St in 2023.

stops.name: The Meat Market / Cimino's Cafe
stops.line: Butcher shop and deli with Boar's Head cold cuts, hot and cold subs, breakfast and lunch, and catering; 40th anniversary September 2025.

stops.name: Belle Isle Seafood

stops.name: Adriana's Cafe

stops.name: Winthrop Marketplace

stops.name: Winthrop House of Pizza

stops.name: Happy Garden

stops.name: Pan-Centro Family Pastry Shop

stops.name: 90 Restaurant

stops.name: Honey Dew Donuts

stops.name: Dunkin'

stops.name: Hi-Tide

stops.name: Express Burritos Mexican Grill

stops.name: Odyssey Grill & Pizza

stops.line: Coffee, donuts, bagels and breakfast sandwiches.
